title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Magic Vault to other apps and choose what gets posted where.

discord.heading: Discord
discord.description: Post scans and alerts to your Discord server.
discord.botUnreachable: Couldn't reach the Discord bot, so channel names and permissions can't be shown right now.
discord.botNotInServer: The bot isn't in your linked server anymore. Add it back, then link again.

channelSettings.heading: Channels
channelSettings.description: Where every scan and every error or alert gets posted. Only owners and admins can change these.

overrides.heading: Collection overrides
overrides.description: Send one collection's scans or errors to a different channel. Collections without an override use the channels above.
overrides.empty: No overrides. Every collection uses the channels above.

overrideDialog.title: Add collection override
overrideDialog.description: Pick a collection and where its scans or errors should go instead.
overrideDialog.noCollections: No matching collections without an override.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Turn the every-scan feed on or off, and send a test message to check your channels.

rules.heading: Notification rules
rules.description: Post a card to a channel when it matches a rule. Every matching rule posts, so one card can go to several channels, but each channel gets it once.
rules.needsGame: Pick a collection with a game to add notification rules.
rules.noChannel: No channel. Edit the rule to pick one.
rules.limitReached_one: The free plan includes {{count}} Discord notification rule. Upgrade to Business for unlimited rules.
rules.limitReached_other: The free plan includes {{count}} Discord notification rules. Upgrade to Business for unlimited rules.

ruleDialog.description: When a scanned card matches these conditions, it's posted to this channel.
ruleDialog.name: Name
ruleDialog.roleHint: Mentions this role when a card matches. Greyed-out roles can't be pinged by the bot: make them mentionable in Discord, or give the bot the "Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles" permission.
